title: GSX-R1000R Superbike (Urban Commuter)
description: Representing Suzuki's engineering ethos in the Adventure Tourer class, the Suzuki GSX-R1000R Superbike (Urban Commuter) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its chassis dynamics into punchy mid-range acceleration. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
